title: Understanding the Hat Matrix
text: The hat matrix $H$ is used in linear regression to project the observed values onto the fitted values. It is defined as $H=X(X**TX)**{-1}X**T$. This matrix has some special properties that can help in understanding its behavior.

title: Properties of the Hat Matrix
text: One important property of the hat matrix $H$ is that it is idempotent. This means that when you multiply it by itself, you get the same matrix back: $$\$HH=H\$$$. This property is crucial in understanding how the matrix behaves in projections.

hintAnswer: It means that when the matrix is multiplied by itself, the result is the same matrix.
title: Checking Idempotency
text: What does it mean for a matrix to be idempotent?
choices: It means the matrix is symmetric.
It means the matrix is invertible.
It means that when the matrix is multiplied by itself, the result is the same matrix.
It means the matrix is diagonal.
